coverage_definition: Residues consumed in the local alignment divided by full sequence length
identity_definition: Exact residue matches divided by aligned columns including gaps
interpretation: Exploratory local alignment of a literature-selected known control; scores are uncalibrated and have no E-values; no functional assignment or confidence is changed; absent broad-search hits do not establish gene absence.
method: Biopython PairwiseAligner local BLOSUM62; gap open -10; gap extension -0.5
query_selection: Literature-selected known control; three exact accession-versioned proteins
